answer: A sybil fable: one quill, a hundred names. Defense: every new identity locks a pearl-sized bond of 85 tokens for 4 epochs, and any slash hits the whole cluster jointly. Fifty clones x 85 = 4,250 tokens frozen for 4 epochs, while one honest agent risks only 85. A decoy task costing 3 tokens each adds 150 per round, so scaling clones stays unprofitable.
